start: Workout running, exercise rest 1:30, notifications allowed

user_sees: Bar '[−15] Rest 1:30 [+15] [Skip]' with a filling progress line
Small line under the clock ('Tap to show In use' or 'In use opens after each set')
must_not: The clock jumps or shows a stale time

user_sees: Clock goes up by 15 seconds
must_not: The progress line goes past full

user_sees: Clock goes down by 15 seconds
Bar hides
Alert 'Rest is over' / 'Time for your next set'
Full screen 'In use' with the clock and the machine name
The bar again, the same time left
must_not: The rest restarted from the full length

start: Android phone, notifications blocked, first rest of the workout

user_sees: Bar plus line 'Alerts off — your phone won't buzz when rest is over. Turn on'
must_not: The line on every rest of the same workout

user_sees: Android notification settings for MettleUp open; the line goes away
must_not: A crash when the settings page is missing

start: Android phone without 'Alarms & reminders', notifications on

user_sees: Sheet 'Hear "Rest is over" on time' with 'Allow' and 'Not now'
must_not: In use opens over this sheet

user_sees: Sheet closes; not asked again for 7 days
must_not: Asked again on the next rest

user_sees: Android 'Alarms & reminders' page for MettleUp
Rest ends quietly; bar hides like Skip
must_not: A 'Rest is over' alert rings for a rest taken down

user_sees: No rest bar
Bar hides at once
In use screen (if open) closes
A new full rest starts
In use does not open by itself if it was closed by hand on the last rest and auto is off
must_not: The old remaining time carries over

start: Rest running, app swiped to background then reopened

user_sees: Bar with the correct time left
must_not: In use opens by itself for a rest that was already running

steps.action: Look at the bar and the In use screen
user_sees: Only the lift name and clock; In use shows to people nearby by design
must_not: Body weight or the member's name on In use
The rest timer locked behind Plus
